title: 1001-warning truncation vector
method: Hand-derived from the pinned source rules named in provenance; no F1 hydrate, project or serializer output was observed or used. Reviewer arbitration D-02-presence corrects only the representation specified in the disputes receipt; the original independent derivation is retained as provenance.

input.authoredShape: One Definitions element carrying 1001 distinct unknown attributes w0000..w1000 (plus id, targetNamespace and the bpmn declaration); each unknown attribute in a known package raises one native unknown-attribute warning in element construction, in document order.

vectors.derivation: The native reader records one unknown-attribute warning per wNNNN attribute and otherwise builds the tree. The boundary emits the first 1000 as moddle-warning diagnostics in document order and caps the stream: the 1001st warning (w1000) is not emitted as a warning; a single moddle-warning-truncated diagnostic points at its projected location. The element stays under the 1024 attributes-per-element limit (1003 attributes in total), so no attribute-count refusal precedes the cap.
provenance: plan rev d: moddle-warning-truncated row, 1000 cap and 1001-warning vector
moddle-xml element construction: unknown attribute in a known package records a warning and retains the attribute
